evidence_semantics: A true capability means a source-level production path is wired in this repository. It does not prove that a model/resource is installed, a provider is configured, a permission is granted, the host supports it, or the feature has passed physical-device acceptance. False means not currently verified as an available production capability; consult known_limitations.

known_limitations.inference_path: The Android production composition uses ProcessIsolatedModelBackend in the app process, Messenger IPC to InferenceService in :inference, and InAppLlamaModelBackend with LocalInferenceEngine. The process boundary is wired; successful inference still requires a supported GGUF model in Friday private storage and sufficient live host resources.
known_limitations.ollama_backend: OllamaModelBackend and OllamaAdapter remain in the repository for legacy/test/provider purposes. They are not the Android production inference backend. Do not infer a running Ollama server or localhost:11434/8080 dependency from their presence.
known_limitations.llama_cpp_adapter: LlamaCppAdapter is an optional provider adapter with loopback defaults. Its existence does not prove a llama-server process is installed, started, healthy, or used by the production turn path.
known_limitations.cloud_reasoning: TurnPathAssembly currently constructs CloudModelRouter with an empty provider list. No cloud reasoning provider is configured by this composition.
known_limitations.model_availability: No model is considered installed or loaded merely because a catalogue entry or backend exists. Runtime model selection is subject to private-file resolution, NAE admission, native load success, and per-turn resource re-admission.
known_limitations.voice: Voice source paths and components exist, but this manifest does not certify target-device microphone lifecycle, Egyptian Arabic recognition quality, voice quality, wake-word reliability, or end-to-end interruption latency.
known_limitations.memory_and_learning: Local memory and cognitive/continuity components exist. This does not prove the full experience-to-persistent-internal-change-to-generalized-later-behaviour acceptance requirement.
known_limitations.self_rebuild: The in-app builder is bounded to declarative tools and isolated validation. It cannot yet rewrite arbitrary Kotlin/Android source, compile, sign, or replace the installed APK.
known_limitations.signing_and_updates: A production release requires the permanent signing keystore and all five FRIDAY_RELEASE_* repository secrets described in docs/FRIDAY_RELEASE_SIGNING_SETUP.md. CI debug artifacts and disposable CI signing are not production releases.
known_limitations.physical_device: GitHub emulator/instrumentation evidence is not evidence of installation, microphone behaviour, performance, or update continuity on the owner's physical phone.
known_limitations.self_study: The packaged source index contains structural metadata (paths, packages, declarations and imports), not source text or proof of semantic source comprehension.
known_limitations.termux_recovery: Friday can submit a fixed bootstrap through Termux RUN_COMMAND and install a Termux:Boot worker that uses Shizuku rish to detect Friday's stopped package state and request relaunch. The owner must enable allow-external-apps, grant RUN_COMMAND, initialize Termux:Boot, install rish and its DEX in Termux HOME, and authorize Termux in Shizuku. A request being submitted is not proof that the worker started. Physical-device force-stop recovery, reboot persistence and OEM process survival remain unverified.
known_limitations.shizuku_recovery: Friday's Shizuku UserService is bound in daemon mode and now contains an owner-controlled recovery supervisor. Shizuku documents that daemon UserServices survive the client app process dying, but are killed when Shizuku itself stops or restarts. The supervisor's actual survival through Android force-stop and successful relaunch must still be proven on the target handset.
